headline: Sales accelerate and guidance rises as margin cools
summary_short: Veralto's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,474M (+7.5% y/y, +3.7% q/q; +4.2% non-GAAP core), while net income grew 8.6% y/y to $241M and diluted EPS reached $0.98 (+10.1% y/y), even as GAAP operating margin slipped to 21.4% from 22.8% a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,474M rose 7.5% y/y (4.2% core) and 3.7% q/q, led by Water Quality's 5.7% core growth. Operating profit of $315M was roughly flat y/y (+0.6%) as $29M of restructuring charges and $17M higher acquisition-related amortization compressed GAAP operating margin to 21.4% from 22.8%; adjusted operating margin was 24.6%. Net income of $241M (+8.6% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.98 (+10.1% y/y) benefited from a lower tax bill ($48M vs $63M), including a ~$0.05/share IEEPA tariff-refund benefit. Free cash flow was $328M. Veralto raised FY2026 core sales growth guidance to 4.0%-4.5% and adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $4.35-$4.43, and guided Q3 adjusted diluted EPS to $1.06-$1.09.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by 4.2% non-GAAP core sales growth (7.6% reported GAAP), led by Water Quality's 5.7% core growth on industrial water treatment, reuse, and water-monitoring demand; PQI core growth was milder at 2.0%.

Operating profit was roughly flat y/y as sales growth was offset by $29M of 2026 Cost Optimization Program restructuring charges and $17M higher acquisition-related intangible amortization, compressing GAAP operating margin to 21.4% from 22.8%.
Net earnings rose faster than operating income as income taxes fell to $48M from $63M, including a disclosed ~$0.05/share one-time benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter.

Veralto raised FY2026 core sales growth guidance to 4.0%-4.5% (from 3.0%-4.5%) and adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $4.35-$4.43 (from $4.20-$4.28), citing expected H2 core growth acceleration to approximately 5%-6%, led by PQI digital workflow adoption.
